figures.title: Figure 5
figures.summary: Original Figure 5. Static PL and TRPL on Al2O3 and TRPL on TiO2 are separate substrate contexts. Panel a is Al2O3 static PL, b Al2O3 TRPL, c TiO2 TRPL; no cross-substrate specimen join. Panel-a assignment conflict: the near-infrared maxima are labeled black/pristine rightmost, red/1MA intermediate and green/2.5MA leftmost, whereas main p.6 assigns approximately 1025, 1035 and 1055 nm to pristine, 1MA and 2.5MA respectively. Neither source representation is selected as correct; no numerical plot peaks are inferred. The 5MA approximately 780 nm feature and panels b/c are not contradicted by this order conflict.

conflictPairs.topic: Figure 5a versus main-text PL sample assignment
conflictPairs.context: Main p.6 assigns the near-infrared PL maxima as pristine approximately 1025 nm, 1MA approximately 1035 nm and 2.5MA approximately 1055 nm. Figure 5a on main p.5 instead labels the black pristine maximum rightmost, red 1MA intermediate and green 2.5MA leftmost. The prose and labeled figure therefore disagree on sample assignment/order. Both are retained unresolved; no exact plotted maxima are inferred. This three-peak ordering conflict does not separately contradict the approximately 780 nm 5MA feature or the TRPL panels.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
